selection_rationale: Nine of twelve mechanisms are killed, giving a 100% kill ratio among non-survivors. M786S-01 retains the dyadic prime-reservoir construction, M786S-04 retains the exact A>=4 padding budget, and M786S-07 retains the deterministic and shared-seed adaptive-query lift. The square-root barrier, density dependence, and exclusions for global repair and nonuniform per-input programs are preserved as scope boundaries rather than overclaimed conclusions.
